award_as_published: Students recognized as National Merit Finalists by the National Merit Scholar Corporation, and who are admitted to UAH prior to May 31, will be eligible to receive the National Merit UAH Platinum Scholarship. The National Merit UAH Platinum Scholarships provides: Full tuition (up to 18 credit hours per semester), for a total of eight semesters of undergraduate coursework; One year of on-campus housing at a regular room rate; Course fees up to $500 per academic year; A one-time $3,000 UAH led summer study-abroad allowance (This can only be utilized during a summer term.)
first_choice_as_published: Students must list The University of Alabama in Huntsville as their college choice by May 31.
publisher: The University of Alabama in Huntsville

award_as_published: The University of Alabama offers scholarships for National Merit Finalists and Semifinalists. Value of tuition for up to five years or 10 semesters for degree-seeking undergraduate and graduate or law studies; Four years of on-campus housing at regular room rate (based on assignment by Housing and Residential Communities); $4,000/year undergraduate supplemental scholarship for four years; $2,000 one-time allowance for research or international study (after completing one year of undergraduate study at UA)
first_choice_as_published: List The University of Alabama as college of choice with the National Merit Scholarship Corporation before May 1, 2027
apply_deadline_as_published: Submit an application and all supporting documents by the December 4 priority deadline

award_as_published: Admitted National Merit Semifinalists with at least a 3.5 GPA after completion of junior year are automatically eligible for the Presidential Scholarship. Presidential Scholarship values can be found on the In-State or Out-of-State and International Freshman Scholarship pages.
Eligible Alabama residents may qualify for the National Scholars Presidential Scholarship ($11,000/year for 4 years). An additional $1,000/year may be possible based on FAFSA eligibility.
first_choice_as_published: Finalists must list Auburn University as their first-choice institution with the National Merit Scholarship Corporation by May 1.

first_choice_as_published: To receive the National Scholar award, you are required to select ASU as your first-choice institution with the National Merit Scholarship Corporation by May 1.

USC also awards a scholarship valued at $20,000 per year for students who are admitted to USC, named National Merit Finalists by the National Merit Corporation, and list USC as their first-choice institution with NMSC.

award_as_published: Florida residents who advance to become National Merit Finalists will be awarded the Benacquisto Scholarship in addition to the Florida Bright Futures Scholarship.
You will be considered for a scholarship upon admission to UCF if you are named a National Merit Semifinalist.
Out-of-state National Merit Finalists are eligible for our competitive National Merit Scholarship package valued at more than $25,000 per year for four years.
first_choice_as_published: If you advance to become a National Merit Finalist and designate UCF as your "first-choice" with the National Merit Scholarship Corporation by the May 31 deadline, you will be considered for an increased award from UCF.

award_as_published: Eligible scholars will receive an award equal to the institutional cost of attendance for an in-state student minus the sum of Bright Futures and any National Merit award. Please note that the value of the Bright Futures can vary each term based on credit hour enrollment, so the overall total of the Benacquisto Award can fluctuate per student. The Benacquisto Scholarship disbursement can range between $16,000 - $25,000 per year, but it will always equal the full in-state cost of attendance.
first_choice_as_published: If you are a National Merit Finalist, you must list FSU as your first-choice institution by May 1.

award_as_published: Florida State University's Out-of-State National Merit Award scholarship package has a total value of approximately $91,808 distributed across four years. It includes a 100 percent out-of-state tuition waiver, a $16,000*, Vires scholarship, and a $2000 NMSC stipend (if college sponsored). *Admitted first-year students starting Fall 2024.
first_choice_as_published: If you are a National Merit Finalist, you must list FSU as your first-choice institution by May 1.

award_as_published: As a National Merit Finalist, you're guaranteed a four-year scholarship at University of Idaho when you declare U of I as your first-choice institution. first_choice_as_published: Declare University of Idaho as first school of choice with the National Merit Scholarship Corporation by their deadline of May 31.
